beats.title: pictures over music as Knuckles gets ready

beats.text: Now ya ready?
Where'd you get these flowers from?
*chuckles* Don't worry about them, now go! Make a move! *pushes him towards Tikal's table*
( Here goes nothing ) *walking towards Tikal's table*
That's so cool!
I know right! I'm so using them for the prom
can't wait!
*sigh* Me t-
Good afternoon, ladies
Hi Knuckles!
Someone is looking very pretty today, this may be her lucky day! *giving flowers to Tikal*
... *taking the flowers*
*looking on the piece of paper* My beautiful.. beautiful-
I can't hear you over the crowds!
EVERYONE CAN I HAVE YOUR ATTENTION PLEASE?

beats.cap: *Everyone stops talking and looks towards Sonic*

beats.text: My friend, Knuckles. Has something very important to say
( Great, you've made it even worst for me pal )

beats.cap: *Everyone stays completely silence and stares at Knuckles*

beats.text: Go ahead Knuckles, we're waiting
*gulp* *reading the lines on the paper* My beautiful beautiful... lady
I love you sweet as roses, that fly by my face...
*giggles* ( Sonic wrote that )
I'm very sorry for being a.. big ass grump to you lately.. ( SONIC! )
So will you-
What the hell?! *snatches paper off him* You're seriously using a sheet just to say such romantic sentances?!
Look, all I'm trying to say is will you-
Enough talking, I'd love to go to the prom with you
Now everybody's happy again!
I'm guessing Sonic wrote that novel for you
How'd you know?

beats.cap: *shows him the bottom of the paper*

beats.text: Sonic wrote this, because Knuckles is stupid >:D
SOOOOOONNNNNNIIIIICCCCC!!
*chuckles nervously*
*walks into cafeteria* WHO STOLE MY FLOWERS?!
I guess I should get going.. *dashes out the cafeteria*
SOOONNNIIICCC!
